blocks.text: Algorithm ko us ki kaarkardagi (waqt aur memory ka istemal), scalability (input barhne par kaarkard rehna) aur khaas masle ke liye munasibat se parkha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Algorithm ki kaarkardagi parakhne ke aham awamil bataiye (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Time complexity (waqt kaise barhta hai), space complexity (memory kaise barhti hai), bare inputs ke saath scalability, aur masle ki zaroorat aur data ke liye munasibat; durustagi pehle se farz hai.

items: Algorithms ko kaarkardagi, scalability aur munasibat se parkhein.
